section_summary.extract_value: This section describes applications of the BAS-2 across research, clinical, prevention, educational, and community settings and discusses the revised wording of Item 8. It explicitly references Study 3 (a sample of community women and men) and also refers back to Studies 1 and 2 in relation to the original Item 8 wording. The section recommends options for using or adapting Item 8 and suggests contexts (eating disorder treatment, college counseling, community programs, and schools) where the BAS-2 could be implemented.
